command: set -euo pipefail; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); echo UTC=$(date -u +%FT%TZ); for d in /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-2.0 /home/ai-core-node/clay-global-research-entity /home/ai-core-node/oMEGAcV1; do echo REPO=$d; if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo BRANCH=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current); echo HEAD=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD); echo DIRTY_COUNT=$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain | wc -l); echo ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git -C "$d" ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}'); else echo MISSING_GIT=1; fi; done; echo SERVICE_LOCAL_BRIDGE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service 2>/dev/null || true); echo SERVICE_BUEHNE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service 2>/dev/null || true); echo ACTIVE_CRUSH_BEGIN; pgrep -af '/crush|harness_crush_knopf|codex exec|claude' | tail -n 20 || true; echo ACTIVE_CRUSH_END
